summary: F is conjugation by P after the inclusion O ⊆ ℚ̄_ℓ; conjugation preserves determinants and traces.

steps.claim: Take P ∈ GL_n(ℚ̄_ℓ) with u(g) = P⁻¹R(g)P and F(A) = P·A·P⁻¹ (A read in M_n(ℚ̄_ℓ) entrywise), an O-algebra map; it is injective (cancel the conjugation and the injective inclusion O ⊆ ℚ̄_ℓ).
steps.lean:
R g) ∧ ∀ A, (F A).det = A.det.1 ∧ (F A).trace = A.trace := h.elim fun (P : ConjAct _) h ↦
  ⟨(MulSemiringAction.toAlgHom O _ P).comp (Algebra.ofId ..).mapMatrix, fun _ ↦ by

steps.claim: F(u(g)) = P·P⁻¹R(g)P·P⁻¹ = R(g) for every g.
det(PAP⁻¹) = det A and tr(PAP⁻¹) = tr A, and both commute with the inclusion O ⊆ ℚ̄_ℓ.
steps.lean: fun A ↦ by erw [det_units_conj, trace_units_conj]; simp [Matrix.trace, det_apply]⟩
